lines.zh: 我走过墓道，尘土没惊动。
lines.en: I cross the tomb passage without stirring the dust.

lines.zh: 铁靴压着碎骨，声音很轻。
lines.en: Iron boots press the bone shards, softly.

lines.zh: 这具身子比生前沉得多。
lines.en: This body is far heavier than it was alive.

lines.zh: 我沿着塌了的宫墙走。
lines.en: I walk along the fallen palace wall.

lines.zh: 每走一步，甲里都有回声。
lines.en: Every step echoes inside my hollow armor.

lines.zh: 我巡视这座没有人的王朝。
lines.en: I patrol this dynasty with no people left.

lines.zh: 棺盖开了，我就从那里出来。
lines.en: The coffin lid opened, and I came out.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，灰会浮起来。
lines.en: Ash rises wherever my feet have been.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头，还是走廊。
lines.en: At the end of the corridor, another corridor.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为路太长。
lines.en: I walk slowly because the road is long.

lines.zh: 头上的火把早灭了，我看得见。
lines.en: The torches died long ago; I still see.

lines.zh: 有声音从上面传来，我抬头。
lines.en: A sound from above; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我的影子比石柱还宽。
lines.en: My shadow is wider than the stone pillars.

lines.zh: 我往墓室深处走，那里更黑。
lines.en: I walk deeper into the tomb, where it is darker.

lines.zh: 我站着，盔甲里没有呼吸声。
lines.en: I stand still; no breath sounds in my armor.

lines.zh: 剑尖抵着地，我扶着它。
lines.en: My sword's tip rests on the floor; I lean on it.

lines.zh: 这座墓里，只剩我一个守卫。
lines.en: Only one guard is left in this tomb.

lines.zh: 我记得王朝覆灭那天的火。
lines.en: I remember the fire on the day the dynasty fell.

lines.zh: 有虫在甲缝里爬，我不理。
lines.en: Insects crawl in my seams; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我把剑换了个方向握。
lines.en: I turn the sword in my grip.

lines.zh: 墓顶渗水，滴在我肩上。
lines.en: Water seeps from the ceiling onto my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我数着石棺的数目。
lines.en: I count the stone coffins in the dark.

lines.zh: 活着的时候，我也这样站岗。
lines.en: I stood guard like this when I was alive.

lines.zh: 铁甲生锈了，我擦不掉。
lines.en: The armor has rusted; I cannot wipe it off.

lines.zh: 有风，但这里没有出口。
lines.en: There is wind here, but there is no exit.

lines.zh: 我低头，看见自己的手骨。
lines.en: I look down and see the bones of my hand.

lines.zh: 远处的脚步，我分得出是活人。
lines.en: Distant footsteps — I can tell they are living.

lines.zh: 我把面甲放下来，遮住脸。
lines.en: I lower my visor to cover my face.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛，会反光。
lines.en: Living eyes catch the light.

lines.zh: 你站在门口，挡住了风。
lines.en: You stand in the doorway, blocking the wind.

lines.zh: 这身甲，你穿不起。
lines.en: You could not wear armor like this.

lines.zh: 你袖口沾着铁傀儡的锈。
lines.en: There is iron golem rust on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是看你还剩多少血。
lines.en: I stare to see how much blood you have left.

lines.zh: 你不该走进这座墓。
lines.en: You should not have walked into this tomb.

lines.zh: 你的剑在抖，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Your sword trembles; I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 你也是被埋在这里的？
lines.en: Were you buried here as well?

lines.zh: 我抬手，只是扶正头盔。
lines.en: I raise my hand only to right my helm.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，很好。
lines.en: You stepped back. That is wise.

lines.zh: 这张脸，我好像在哪见过。
lines.en: That face — I think I have seen it before.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，照不亮我。
lines.en: The torch in your hand cannot light me.

lines.zh: 甲挡住了大半，剩下的我受着。
lines.en: The armor takes most of it; I take the rest.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，剑没松。
lines.en: I step back; the sword stays in my grip.

lines.zh: 这具身子不流血，只掉灰。
lines.en: This body does not bleed; it sheds dust.

lines.zh: 你打的地方，正好是旧伤。
lines.en: You hit exactly where the old wound is.

lines.zh: 五十点血，我数得清。
lines.en: Fifty points of life; I can count them.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，还连着。
lines.en: A bone cracked, and it is still attached.

lines.zh: 我不喊疼，喊了也没人听。
lines.en: I do not cry out; no one would hear.

lines.zh: 面甲歪了，我扶正。
lines.en: My visor is askew; I straighten it.

lines.zh: 这一下，把墓土震掉了。
lines.en: That shook the grave soil off my shoulders.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，可惜不够。
lines.en: You hit hard, but not quite hard enough.

lines.zh: 金子…我记得国库的味道。
lines.en: Gold... I remember the smell of the treasury.

lines.zh: 你把铁锭举起来，我看见了。
lines.en: You lift the iron ingot; I can see it.

lines.zh: 这身甲若能换新，我愿意谈。
lines.en: If this armor could be renewed, I would talk.

lines.zh: 我死后，还没摸过新剑。
lines.en: Since dying, I have not touched a new sword.

lines.zh: 那块钻石，是从王冠上拆的？
lines.en: Was that diamond pried from a crown?

lines.zh: 别拿食物引我，我早不吃了。
lines.en: Do not lure me with food; I stopped eating long ago.

lines.zh: 我跟着发光的东西走。
lines.en: I follow whatever happens to glitter.

lines.zh: 你把它放下，我就退开。
lines.en: Set it down, and I will step back.

lines.zh: 这堆陪葬品，本来就是我的。
lines.en: These grave goods were mine to begin with.

lines.zh: 我伸手，是因为手还记得。
lines.en: I reach out because my hand still remembers.

lines.zh: 撞上我，像撞一座石碑。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a gravestone.

lines.zh: 你退开，甲上留下你的手印。
lines.en: You pull away, leaving a handprint on my armor.

lines.zh: 别推，我脚下是空的。
lines.en: Do not push; there is hollow ground beneath me.

lines.zh: 我侧身，剑柄撞到墙。
lines.en: I turn, and my hilt strikes the wall.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的披风角了。
lines.en: You are standing on the corner of my cloak.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，灰都扬起来。
lines.en: We collide, and the ash rises around us.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲很硬，你的锁骨小心。
lines.en: My pauldron is hard; mind your collarbone.

lines.zh: 让开，我不习惯绕路。
lines.en: Move; I am not used to walking around people.

lines.zh: 你贴这么近，是想偷我的剑？
lines.en: So close — are you after my sword?

lines.zh: 碰撞的声音，在墓里传得很远。
lines.en: The knock carries far through the tomb.

lines.zh: 我的王后躺在最里面那口棺。
lines.en: My queen lies in the coffin farthest in.

lines.zh: 缠魂骑士和我守同一道门。
lines.en: The Haunted Knight and I guard the same door.

lines.zh: 死人不成家。
lines.en: The dead do not start families.

lines.zh: 我们成婚那天，殿里挂满铁甲。
lines.en: On our wedding day, the hall was hung with armor.

lines.zh: 她现在不认得我了。
lines.en: She does not know me anymore.

lines.zh: 两个人的岗，如今一个人站。
lines.en: A post for two is now held by one.

lines.zh: 我给她留了一盏灯，早灭了。
lines.en: I left a lamp for her; it went out long ago.

lines.zh: 别替我找伴，我身上有墓土。
lines.en: Do not find me a partner; I am covered in grave soil.

lines.zh: 并肩的日子，比王朝长。
lines.en: The days side by side outlasted the dynasty.

lines.zh: 等这座墓塌了，我就去找她。
lines.en: When this tomb falls, I will go to her.

lines.zh: 地上那把断剑，我捡起来。
lines.en: I pick up the broken sword on the floor.

lines.zh: 陪葬的东西，我按原位放回。
lines.en: I put the grave goods back where they belong.

lines.zh: 这枚铜钱，是哪个朝代的？
lines.en: Which dynasty minted this copper coin?

lines.zh: 我弯腰，甲里的骨头响。
lines.en: I bend, and the bones in my armor creak.

lines.zh: 铁锭我收着，甲还能补。
lines.en: I keep the iron; the armor can still be patched.

lines.zh: 钻石太亮，我藏进盔里。
lines.en: The diamond is too bright; I hide it in my helm.

lines.zh: 手甲太厚，抓了两次才起。
lines.en: My gauntlet is thick; I grab twice to lift it.

lines.zh: 这顶头盔，比我戴的小。
lines.en: This helm is smaller than the one I wear.

lines.zh: 有人来过，东西被翻乱了。
lines.en: Someone has been here; the goods are disturbed.

lines.zh: 捡东西时，我总先看四周。
lines.en: When I pick things up, I check around first.

lines.zh: 活人踏进墓室，灯就该灭了。
lines.en: A living one enters the tomb; the lamps should die.

lines.zh: 你踩响了陪葬的陶片。
lines.en: You stepped on a buried pottery shard.

lines.zh: 这口棺，不许你碰。
lines.en: You may not touch that coffin.

lines.zh: 我的剑已经举起来了。
lines.en: My sword is already raised above you.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，让墓顶滴水。
lines.en: Your warmth makes the tomb ceiling drip.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡也拦不住我，何况你。
lines.en: Even an iron golem cannot stop me, much less you.

lines.zh: 王朝没了，守卫还在。
lines.en: The dynasty is gone; the guard remains.

lines.zh: 你退到哪，都是墓里。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, you are still in the tomb.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，太吵。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat; it is much too loud.

lines.zh: 棺盖响了一下，它认出了你。
lines.en: The coffin lid knocked once; it knows you.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，会招来别的东西。
lines.en: Your torch will draw other things down here.

lines.zh: 这具身子只剩五十点血，够用。
lines.en: This body has only fifty left; enough.

lines.zh: 我守了几百年，不差这一晚。
lines.en: I have guarded centuries; one more night is nothing.

lines.zh: 把剑放下，我许你走出去。
lines.en: Drop your sword, and I will let you walk out.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，脚步声在墓里绕。
lines.en: I follow; my footsteps circle through the tomb.

lines.zh: 你跑过三道门，我在第四道等。
lines.en: You pass three doors; I wait at the fourth.

lines.zh: 你踩过的灰，还没落下。
lines.en: The ash you kicked up has not settled yet.

lines.zh: 别往上爬，梯子早烂了。
lines.en: Do not climb; the ladder rotted long ago.

lines.zh: 你的火光，隔着两堵墙都看得见。
lines.en: I see your torchlight through two solid walls.

lines.zh: 我不用追快，这座墓没有出口。
lines.en: I need not hurry; this tomb has no exit.

lines.zh: 你回头看了我一眼，就慢了。
lines.en: You looked back at me once, and slowed.

lines.zh: 剑拖在地上，声音跟着你。
lines.en: My sword drags; the sound follows you.

lines.zh: 你在数门，我在数你。
lines.en: You are counting doors; I am counting you.

lines.zh: 这层墓砖下面，全是空的。
lines.en: Beneath these tomb tiles, everything is hollow.

lines.zh: 你躲进侧室，那是我放甲的地方。
lines.en: You hide in the side room where I keep armor.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到，人后到。
lines.en: My shadow arrives before the rest of me.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我听得清楚。
lines.en: You are breathing hard; I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 再往前，就是主的棺了。
lines.en: Any further, and you reach my lord's coffin.

lines.zh: 这一剑从肩上落下，很慢很重。
lines.en: This cut falls from my shoulder, slow and heavy.

lines.zh: 我横扫，墓砖被削掉一角。
lines.en: I sweep, and a corner of the tomb tile shears off.

lines.zh: 弹射物伤不了我，走近些。
lines.en: Projectiles cannot hurt me; come closer.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，我也不怕。
lines.en: I do not fear falling from a height either.

lines.zh: 剑锋带着墓里的寒气。
lines.en: The blade carries the chill of the tomb.

lines.zh: 三下连击，你只接住两下。
lines.en: Three blows in a row; you caught only two.

lines.zh: 我抬手，甲片像门一样合上。
lines.en: I raise my arm; the plates close like a door.

lines.zh: 这一击，是缠魂骑士教我的。
lines.en: The Haunted Knight taught me this strike.

lines.zh: 我砸地，碎石往你脚边滚。
lines.en: I strike the floor; rubble rolls to your feet.

lines.zh: 你的盾凹了，手还麻着。
lines.en: Your shield dented, and your arm is still numb.

lines.zh: 我不喊，剑声够你听。
lines.en: I do not shout; the sword speaks loudly enough.

lines.zh: 往后退也没用，我够得着。
lines.en: Retreating will not help; my reach is long.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你钉在门框上。
lines.en: This blow pins you against the doorframe.

lines.zh: 打完，我把剑立回原处。
lines.en: After the blow, I set my sword back upright.

lines.zh: 墓顶的土落下来，我先动。
lines.en: Soil falls from the ceiling; I move first.

lines.zh: 棺盖被从里面推开。
lines.en: The coffin lid is pushed open from inside.

lines.zh: 我坐起来，盔甲里全是灰。
lines.en: I sit up, my armor full of dust.

lines.zh: 王朝的名字，我已经忘了。
lines.en: I have forgotten the dynasty's name.

lines.zh: 这具身子只有五十点血，可我醒了。
lines.en: This body has only fifty, yet I woke.

lines.zh: 壁上的灯，自己亮了。
lines.en: The lamps on the wall light themselves.

lines.zh: 我把剑从石缝里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull my sword from the stone fissure.

lines.zh: 有人动了封印，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone disturbed the seal; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比门框还高一点。
lines.en: I stand, a little taller than the doorframe.

lines.zh: 墓道里的风，先替我开路。
lines.en: The wind in the passage clears my way.

lines.zh: 我记得要守的东西，却忘了为什么。
lines.en: I remember what to guard, not why.

lines.zh: 甲上的锈，是一片一片的。
lines.en: The rust on my armor comes off in flakes.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，脚下的砖陷下去。
lines.en: I lift a foot, and the tile sinks.

lines.zh: 又一座墓，又多一个守卫。
lines.en: Another tomb, another guard to keep it.

lines.zh: 火在甲上烧，我闻到自己。
lines.en: Fire burns on my armor; I smell myself.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，我站得稳。
lines.en: Dropped from a height, I land steady.

lines.zh: 水灌进墓室，我下沉得很慢。
lines.en: Water floods the tomb; I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了我，甲还扣着。
lines.en: The blast throws me high; I come down on my feet.

lines.zh: 箭碰到甲就弹开了。
lines.en: The arrow glances off my armor.

lines.zh: 法术绕过铁甲，咬进骨头。
lines.en: The spell slips past iron and bites the bone.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿是活着的事。
lines.en: I do not eat; hunger belongs to the living.

lines.zh: 雷顺着剑走，我握得更紧。
lines.en: Lightning runs up my sword; I grip it tighter.

lines.zh: 掉下去时，我还抓着剑。
lines.en: Falling, I still hold my sword.
